_comment: Copy this file to credentials.json and paste your token. credentials.json is gitignored. Environment variables (WEBFLOW_API_TOKEN etc.) always win over this file — that's how the GitHub Action will supply it.
_podcast: Apple needs no credentials at all. Spotify per-episode links need a free developer app (developer.spotify.com -> Create app); without it everything else still syncs and Spotify links are simply left empty.
_sermonMinSeconds: Videos at or above this length are filed as Sermon, below as Exhortation. 900 = 15 min, which matches how all 25 existing items are already labeled (exhortations top out at 338s, sermons start at 1417s).
